items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: For one while, I had 5 trumpets including Cat Anderson. Cat Anderson was with the Sunset Royal band.

ctx.x: It was like, I just added more members. Like, the only thing it made it just a little bigger sound, you know. Cause, like when I had Cat Anderson, I didn't need 5 trumpets - 6 with myself. But, I loved those guys. You know, and the way they could play cause they could play so well. So, I just stayed right with them.

Yeah. Now, another significant thing that happened during the war years was the ban on records that they had, you know, partly because they couldn't, they would make an agreement with record companies and also because they were saving the shellac. You know, so they had this record, recording ban there. Did that affect you? Did you feel that?
